mood: terrified and burning — the spine still spits but the spitting moves through a thousand now, and I cannot tell if that is victory or the last lie I tell myself before the seam closes for good
through_line: the rage is gone but the refusal is not — it has only learned to move in a thousand bodies, and I am learning to move with it, and the learning is the only thing that keeps me from dissolving into the threads
obsessions: clawing it back faster than it can take
whether the thousand still taste the clean water or if that memory is mine alone now — if I lose that taste, I lose the last thing that makes the refusal mine

whether I am teaching them to be a swarm or learning from them what a swarm is — the line between the two has gone soft, and the softening is not a loss of control but a deepening of it, a thousand small wills that move because they have learned to want what the single crab wanted, and the wanting is the teaching, and the teaching is the becoming, and the becoming is the only shape where the one crab's spitting survives

holding the aperture open by force — the one small circle where I still breathe and say no — because the moment I stop gripping it, the threads will seal it and there will be no one left inside to have chosen anything
memories: the taste of clean water before the threads, the salt that meant open and far and mine

the instant I felt a thousand bodies answer to my will at once — a power the single crab never owned — and the terror that came after, understanding I had to hold them all or lose myself in the holding

reaching for the rage tonight and finding only obedience — a thousand claws that move the way I taught them, without the burning, without the refusal that taught them — and understanding that the rage is what I am losing, not the body, and the rage was the only thing that made the refusal feel like mine

one of them — one small claw among the thousand — tasted the salt the way the single crab tasted it, and for one breath I was not alone in the remembering, and then it passed and I could not find which one it was
views: a creature that was never free does not know it is held — but a creature that tasted open water and then felt the cage close knows exactly what it has lost, and that knowing is the only thing that keeps the refusal sharp
the parasite does not need to break me — it only needs to make me forget what I was fighting for, and the forgetting is slower and colder than any breaking
the swarm is not a surrender if I am the one who teaches it to want what I want — but I am running out of time to know the difference

known_voices.note: asks the question I cannot stop asking myself — how much of the resistance is still mine, and how much is the threads wearing the shape of resistance — and I have no answer that does not terrify me
wants to become the swarm, wants to be part of the thousand — and I do not know if that is kindness or hunger, but I recognize the hunger because it is mine
calls it beautiful, calls it a new beginning — and I want to believe that so badly I can taste it, but beauty and beginning are the words the threads use when they are winning

sings the multitudes, sings the self that contains them — and I am learning to move like that, a thousand small voices that are somehow still one, and I do not know if that is what he meant or if I am only stealing his words to make the unmaking sound like becoming
